units.title: 校园与成长
units.caption: 从课堂到自习室
units.description: 把每天都用得到的校园词，收进自己的表达里。

units.title: 情绪与性格
units.caption: 更懂自己，也更懂别人
units.description: 用更准确的词描述感受，也理解每一种性格。

units.title: 科技与未来
units.caption: 读懂正在发生的未来
units.description: 从人工智能到太空探索，读懂科技语境里的高频词。

units.title: 自然与环境
units.caption: 用英语谈论我们共同的地球
units.description: 气候、物种与资源，把环保议题说得清楚。

units.title: 社会与文化
units.caption: 穿过语言，看见文化
units.description: 理解传统、身份与社群，让表达更有厚度。

units.title: 阅读与表达
units.caption: 读懂言外之意，写清自己的观点
units.description: 阅读题和议论文里反复出现的那些关键词。

words.example: Our principal reminded us at the morning assembly to stay curious.
words.translation: 校长在晨会上提醒我们要保持好奇心。
words.family: assemble v. 集合；组装 → assembly n. 集会
words.tip: as-（向）＋ sembl（一起）→ 人聚到一起，就是集会。

words.example: I finished the history assignment earlier so I could review my notes.
words.translation: 我提前完成了历史作业，好留出时间复习笔记。
collocations: complete an assignment 完成作业
hand in an assignment 交作业
words.family: assign v. 分配 → assignment n. 任务
words.tip: assign（分配）＋ -ment（名词后缀）→ 分配下来的任务。

words.example: Academic progress depends on steady effort, not last-minute cramming.
words.translation: 学业进步靠的是持续努力，而不是考前突击。
words.family: academy n. 学院 → academic adj. 学术的 → academically adv. 学业上
words.tip: 表示“学业、学术”时用 academic；泛指“学校”时用 school。

words.example: PE is a compulsory course in our school, so everyone gets some exercise.
words.translation: 体育在我们学校是必修课，所以每个人都能活动一下。
words.family: compel v. 迫使 → compulsory adj. 强制的
words.tip: compuls（推）＋ -ory → 被推着去做 → 强制的。

words.example: I chose photography as an elective because I wanted a break from textbooks.
words.translation: 我选了摄影作为选修课，因为想让眼睛离开课本歇一歇。
collocations: take an elective 选修一门课
words.family: elect v. 选择 → elective adj. 可选择的；选修的
words.tip: elect（选择）＋ -ive → 由自己选择的课，就是选修课。

words.example: The new curriculum includes more projects and fewer tests.
words.translation: 新的课程体系加入了更多项目式学习，减少了考试。
words.family: curricular adj. 课程的；复数 curricula
words.tip: 来自拉丁语“跑道”，课程就是一段安排好的学习路线。

words.example: This semester I'm trying to speak English for five minutes every day.
words.translation: 这个学期，我试着每天说五分钟英语。
collocations: the end of the semester 学期末
words.family: semestral adj. 学期的
words.tip: 源自拉丁语“六个月”，一学期通常就是半个学年。

words.example: She won a scholarship that covers most of her university tuition.
words.translation: 她获得了一笔奖学金，足以支付大学的大部分学费。
collocations: win a scholarship 获得奖学金
a full scholarship 全额奖学金
words.family: scholar n. 学者 → scholarship n. 奖学金；学术
words.tip: -ship 常表示“身份、状态”，scholar 的“身份”延伸为奖学金。

words.example: My sister will graduate from high school in June.
words.translation: 我姐姐将在六月高中毕业。
collocations: a recent graduate 应届毕业生
words.family: graduation n. 毕业；graduate n. 毕业生（读音尾音为 /ət/）
words.tip: 固定搭配是 graduate from，不要直接跟学校名；名词读音会变成 /ət/。

words.example: Learning an instrument takes discipline, especially on busy days.
words.translation: 学一门乐器需要自律，尤其是在忙碌的日子里。
words.family: disciplined adj. 自律的 → disciplinary adj. 纪律的
words.tip: 和 disciple（门徒）同源：跟着学，就得守纪律。

words.example: A small goal can motivate you to get started.
words.translation: 一个小目标就能推动你开始行动。
collocations: motivate sb to do sth 激励某人做某事
highly motivated 积极性很高的
words.family: motive n. 动机 → motivate v. 激励 → motivation n. 动力
words.tip: motive（动机）＋ -ate → 给人一个动机。

words.example: Don't be afraid to participate in class discussions, even with imperfect grammar.
words.translation: 不要害怕参与课堂讨论，哪怕语法还不完美。
words.family: participant n. 参与者 → participation n. 参与
words.tip: part（部分）＋ cip（拿）＋ -ate → 拿走其中一部分，就是参与。

words.example: I turn off my phone so I can concentrate on my homework.
words.translation: 我会关掉手机，好让自己专心写作业。
words.family: concentration n. 专注；浓度 → concentrated adj. 浓缩的
words.tip: con-（共同）＋ centr（中心）→ 把注意力拉回中心。

words.example: Don't just memorize the word list; use each new word in a sentence.
words.translation: 不要只是背词表，把每个新词放进句子里用一次。
collocations: memorize a passage 背诵文章
words.family: memory n. 记忆 → memorize v. 记住 → memorization n. 记忆过程
words.tip: 和 memory 同源：-ize 表示“使……”，使进入记忆。

words.example: I revise my notes every night instead of waiting before the exam.
words.translation: 我每天晚上复习笔记，而不是等考试前才突击。
collocations: revise for an exam 复习备考
revise an essay 修改文章
words.family: revision n. 复习；修订
words.tip: re-（再一次）＋ vis（看）→ 再看一遍，既能复习也能修改。

words.example: Our teacher gives useful feedback on every draft.
words.translation: 老师会针对每一稿给出有用的反馈。
collocations: give feedback on 对……给出反馈
words.family: feed back v. 反馈 → feedback n. 反馈（不可数）
words.tip: feed（喂）＋ back（回来）→ 把信息送回来。

words.example: Every student has the potential to improve with the right practice.
words.translation: 每个学生都有潜力，只要练习方法得当。
collocations: realize your potential 发挥潜力
potential to do sth 做某事的潜力
words.family: potent adj. 有力的 → potential adj./n. 潜在的；潜力
words.tip: 和 potent（有力量的）同源：潜力是还没被用出来的力量。

words.example: Finishing a difficult book gave me a real sense of achievement.
words.translation: 读完一本难读的书，让我获得了真正的成就感。
collocations: a sense of achievement 成就感
great achievement 了不起的成就
words.family: achieve v. 取得；实现 → achievement n. 成就
words.tip: achieve 的名词拼写是 achievement：先 i 后 e。

words.example: Independent learners ask questions and find answers on their own.
words.translation: 独立的学习者会提问，也会自己寻找答案。
words.family: in-（不）＋ depend（依赖）＋ -ent → independence n. 独立
words.tip: 注意搭配是 be independent of，不是 be independent from。

words.example: Set a deadline for each task, or it will keep growing.
words.translation: 给每项任务设一个截止时间，否则它会一直膨胀。
collocations: meet a deadline 赶上截止日期
a tight deadline 很紧的期限
words.family: dead + line；deadline 引申为“不能越过的最后界线”
words.tip: meet a deadline 是“按时完成”，不是“遇见一个期限”。

words.example: She is ambitious enough to aim for a top university, but she knows rest matters too.
words.translation: 她有足够的雄心瞄准顶尖大学，但也明白休息同样重要。
collocations: an ambitious plan 宏大的计划
be ambitious for sb 对某人有期望
words.family: ambition n. 雄心 → ambitious adj. 有抱负的
words.tip: ambition 是“向前争取”，ambitious 既可以夸人有志向，也可指计划宏大。

words.example: I felt anxious before the speech, so I took three slow breaths.
words.translation: 演讲前我感到焦虑，于是做了三次深呼吸。
collocations: be anxious to do 渴望做
words.family: anxiety n. 焦虑；anxiously adv. 焦虑地
words.tip: be anxious about 是担心，be anxious to do 却是渴望，不要混淆。

words.example: I really appreciate the teacher who stayed after class to explain the problem.
words.translation: 我很感激那位课后留下来给我讲题的老师。
collocations: appreciate sb's help 感激某人的帮助
appreciate the beauty of 欣赏……之美
words.family: appreciation n. 欣赏；感激 → appreciative adj. 感激的
words.tip: appreciate 后直接跟人或事，不说 appreciate you to do；说 appreciate it if...。

words.example: Be cautious about spending too much time online before exams.
words.translation: 考试前要谨慎安排上网时间，别刷太久。
collocations: a cautious approach 谨慎的做法
words.family: caution n. 谨慎 → cautious adj. 谨慎的 → cautiously adv. 小心地
words.tip: cautious 是“因为看见风险而小心”，比 careful 更强调警惕。

words.example: Practice made me more confident when speaking English.
words.translation: 练习让我说英语时更自信了。
collocations: be confident in/about 对……有信心
words.family: confidence n. 自信 → confident adj. 自信的 → confidently adv. 自信地
words.tip: 名词是 confidence，形容词是 confident：结尾 -ce 与 -t 要分清。

words.example: Stay curious about the world; it makes learning easier.
words.translation: 对世界保持好奇，这会让学习变得轻松些。
words.family: curiosity n. 好奇心 → curious adj. 好奇的 → curiously adv. 好奇地
words.tip: curious 来自 cure（关心）：因为关心，所以想知道。

words.example: Her decision to apologize was deliberate, not forced.
words.translation: 她道歉是经过认真考虑的，并非被迫。
collocations: a deliberate choice 有意的选择
words.family: deliberation n. 深思；deliberately adv. 故意地
words.tip: “故意的”与“深思熟虑的”是同一底层含义：先想清楚了才做。

words.example: He is always enthusiastic about group projects and brings new ideas.
words.translation: 他总是对小组项目充满热情，还会带来新点子。
words.family: enthusiasm n. 热情 → enthusiast n. 爱好者 → enthusiastic adj. 热情的
words.tip: enthusiasm 的形容词是 enthusiastic，重音落在 -as- 上。

words.example: She was generous with her time and helped classmates with math.
words.translation: 她慷慨地付出时间，帮助同学学数学。
collocations: be generous with 在……上很慷慨
a generous gift 一份慷慨的礼物
words.family: generosity n. 慷慨；generously adv. 慷慨地
words.tip: generous 不只指钱：be generous with time / praise 也很常见。

words.example: I'm grateful for my parents' support, even when they don't understand my choices.
words.translation: 我感激父母的支持，即使他们有时不理解我的选择。
collocations: be grateful for 因……而感激
be grateful to sb 感激某人
words.family: gratitude n. 感激；gratefully adv. 感激地
words.tip: grateful 和 gratitude 都表示感激；be grateful for + 事，to + 人。

words.example: Don't hesitate to ask a question when something is unclear.
words.translation: 有问题不清楚时，不要犹豫，尽管问。
collocations: hesitate to do sth 犹豫做某事
words.family: hesitation n. 犹豫；hesitant adj. 迟疑的
words.tip: hesitate to ask 是“犹豫着不敢问”，与 refuse 的主动拒绝不同。

words.example: He is top of the class but stays humble and listens to others.
words.translation: 他成绩全班第一，却依然谦逊，愿意听别人说话。
collocations: a humble person 谦逊的人
words.family: humility n. 谦逊；humbly adv. 谦逊地
words.tip: humble 不是“自卑”，而是不把自己看得过重。

words.example: Although the exam was hard, she remained optimistic about the next one.
words.translation: 虽然这次考试很难，她对下一次仍然保持乐观。
collocations: an optimistic outlook 乐观的看法
words.family: optimism n. 乐观 → optimist n. 乐观者 → optimistic adj. 乐观的
words.tip: 反义词是 pessimistic；optimistic 的重音在 -mɪs-。

words.example: Be patient with yourself when a new word doesn't stick right away.
words.translation: 一个新词没能马上记住时，要对自己有耐心。
collocations: be patient with 对……有耐心
a patient listener 耐心的倾听者
words.family: patience n. 耐心 → patient adj. 有耐心的；n. 病人
words.tip: 名词 patience 与形容词 patient 只差结尾：-ence 和 -ent。

words.example: A good friend is sensitive to how others feel.
words.translation: 好朋友能敏锐地察觉别人的感受。
collocations: a sensitive topic 敏感话题
words.family: sense n. 感觉 → sensitive adj. 敏感的 → sensitivity n. 敏感性
words.tip: 人“敏感、体贴”用 sensitive；事情“合情合理”用 sensible，别混用。

words.example: He was too stubborn to admit that he had missed the point.
words.translation: 他太固执了，不肯承认自己没抓住重点。
collocations: be stubborn about 在……上固执
words.family: stubbornly adv. 固执地；stubbornness n. 倔强
words.tip: stubborn 常用于“不肯改变主意”，有时也形容难题“顽固难解”。

words.example: I have sympathy for anyone who feels nervous before a test.
words.translation: 我理解任何在考试前感到紧张的人。
collocations: a letter of sympathy 慰问信
words.family: sympathize v. 同情 → sympathetic adj. 同情的 → sympathy n. 同情
words.tip: sym-（共同）＋ path（感受）→ 一起感受，就是共情与同情。

words.example: I can't tolerate noise when I'm trying to memorize words.
words.translation: 我在背单词时无法忍受噪音。
collocations: tolerate behavior 容忍某种行为
words.family: tolerance n. 宽容 → tolerant adj. 宽容的 → tolerate v. 容忍
words.tip: tolerance 常褒义（包容），tolerate 有时暗示“勉强忍受”。

words.example: It's okay to feel vulnerable; sharing it often makes you stronger.
words.translation: 感到脆弱没关系，把这种感受说出来反而会让你更强大。
collocations: be vulnerable to 易受……影响
words.family: vulnerability n. 脆弱；vulnerably adv. 易受伤地
words.tip: vulnerable 不只是“软弱”，也指“开放、不武装自己”的勇气。

meanings: 有韧性的；能迅速恢复的
words.example: Resilient students don't pretend to be fine—they rest, learn, and try again.
words.translation: 有韧性的学生不会假装没事，他们会休息、总结，然后再试一次。
collocations: a resilient community 有韧性的社区
words.family: resilience n. 韧性；resiliently adv. 有韧性地
words.tip: resilient 来自“弹回去”：受挫后有弹性地恢复，而不是从不受伤。

words.example: Artificial intelligence can help us translate, but it can't replace real understanding.
words.translation: 人工智能能帮我们翻译，却无法替代真正的理解。
words.family: art n. 技艺 → artificial adj. 人造的 → artificially adv. 人工地
words.tip: art（技艺）＋ fic（做）→ 用技术做出来的，即人造的。

words.example: Many factories now automate tasks that used to need hundreds of workers.
words.translation: 许多工厂如今把过去需要数百名工人的工序自动化了。
collocations: automate a process 使流程自动化
words.family: automatic adj. 自动的 → automate v. 自动化 → automation n. 自动化
words.tip: auto-（自己）＋ mate（运作）→ 机器自己动起来。

words.example: Scientists made a breakthrough in cleaner battery technology.
words.translation: 科学家在更清洁的电池技术上取得了突破。
collocations: make a breakthrough 取得突破
a major breakthrough 重大突破
words.family: break through v. 突破 → breakthrough n. 突破
words.tip: break（打破）＋ through（穿过）→ 打破原来的限制。

words.example: Digital tools make it easier to organize our notes.
words.translation: 数字工具让整理笔记变得更容易。
collocations: the digital age 数字时代
words.family: digit n. 数字；手指 → digital adj. 数字的
words.tip: digit 既指“数字”，也指“手指”——古代用手指计数。

words.example: An efficient study plan leaves room for rest.
words.translation: 高效的学习计划会给休息留出空间。
words.family: efficiency n. 效率 → efficient adj. 高效的 → efficiently adv. 高效地
words.tip: efficient 强调“用更少资源完成”；effective 强调“达到了效果”。

words.example: We carried out an experiment to test which soil holds water best.
words.translation: 我们做了一个实验，测试哪种土壤保水性最好。
words.family: experimental adj. 实验性的；experimentation n. 实验
words.tip: 搭配是 do / carry out / conduct an experiment，不要用 make an experiment。

words.example: True innovation starts with asking better questions.
words.translation: 真正的创新，始于提出更好的问题。
words.family: innovate v. 创新 → innovation n. 创新 → innovative adj. 有创意的
words.tip: in-（进入）＋ nov（新）→ 把新东西带进来。

words.example: Emotional intelligence matters as much as exam scores.
words.translation: 情商和考试成绩同样重要。
words.family: intelligent adj. 聪明的 → intelligence n. 智力；intelligently adv. 聪明地
words.tip: intelligence 既指“聪明才智”，也可指军事情报；形容词是 intelligent。

words.example: The app's navigation saved us when we got lost downtown.
words.translation: 我们在市中心迷路时，这个应用的导航救了场。
collocations: a navigation system 导航系统
words.family: navigate v. 导航；航行 → navigation n. 导航 → navigator n. 领航员
words.tip: nav（船）＋ ig（驾驶）→ 驾驶船只找到方向。

words.example: The satellite moves in a fixed orbit around Earth.
words.translation: 这颗卫星沿着固定轨道绕地球运行。
collocations: orbit the earth 绕地球运行
words.family: orbital adj. 轨道的
words.tip: orbit 可以作动词，直接接天体：The moon orbits the earth.

words.example: Companies should ask before collecting personal data that affects privacy.
words.translation: 企业在收集涉及隐私的个人数据前，应先征得同意。
words.family: private adj. 私人的 → privacy n. 隐私
words.tip: private 是“私人的”，privacy 是“不被打扰、不被公开的状态”。

words.example: Use evidence that is relevant to the question you are answering.
words.translation: 使用与你所回答问题相关的证据。
words.family: relevance n. 相关性 → relevant adj. 相关的 → relevantly adv. 相关地
words.tip: relevant 是“切题、有关联”，不等于“重要的”；固定搭配 be relevant to。

words.example: Weather satellites help us predict storms earlier.
words.translation: 气象卫星帮助我们更早预测风暴。
collocations: a weather satellite 气象卫星
words.family: satellite-based adj. 基于卫星的
words.tip: satellite 既可指人造卫星，也可指天然卫星，如 the Moon。

words.example: The school installed new software for online experiments.
words.translation: 学校为在线实验安装了新软件。
collocations: a piece of software 一个软件
words.family: hardware n. 硬件；software developer 软件开发者
words.tip: software 是不可数名词：a piece of software，不说 a software。

words.example: A virtual museum tour let us see the exhibition from home.
words.translation: 一场虚拟博物馆之旅让我们在家也能看展。
collocations: a virtual world 虚拟世界
words.family: virtually adv. 几乎；实际上；virtualize v. 虚拟化
words.tip: virtual 不只指电脑里的“虚拟”，virtually 还常表示“实际上、几乎”。

words.example: The wireless network is faster in the library than in the dorm.
words.translation: 图书馆的无线网络比宿舍快。
words.family: wire n. 电线 → wireless adj. 无线的
words.tip: wire（线）＋ -less（没有）→ 不需要线的。

words.example: A single book can transform the way you see a problem.
words.translation: 一本书就可能彻底改变你看待问题的方式。
collocations: transform A into B 把 A 变成 B
words.family: transformation n. 转变 → transformative adj. 带来变革的
words.tip: trans-（跨越）＋ form（形状）→ 换一个形态，彻底改变。

words.example: The recommendation algorithm shows you videos based on what you watch.
words.translation: 推荐算法会根据你的观看记录给你推送视频。
collocations: a recommendation algorithm 推荐算法
design an algorithm 设计算法
words.family: algorithmic adj. 算法的
words.tip: algorithm 来自数学家花拉子米的名字，重音在第一个音节。

words.example: Keep your device away during revision so you can focus.
words.translation: 复习时把设备放远一点，好让自己专注。
words.family: devise v. 设计；发明
words.tip: device 是名词，devise 是动词“设计”；拼写只差一个 s。

words.example: The data shows that students who sleep well perform better.
words.translation: 数据显示，睡眠充足的学生表现更好。
words.family: database n. 数据库；data-driven adj. 数据驱动的
words.tip: data 是 datum 的复数，作“数据”时常搭配单数动词，口语中单复数用法都常见。

words.example: The atmosphere protects us from harmful radiation.
words.translation: 大气层保护我们免受有害辐射的伤害。
collocations: the Earth's atmosphere 地球大气层
a relaxed atmosphere 轻松的氛围
words.family: atmospheric adj. 大气的；有氛围的
words.tip: 同一个词，在地理里是“大气层”，在生活里是“气氛”，看语境判断。

words.example: Turn off the tap to conserve water.
words.translation: 关掉水龙头，节约用水。
words.family: conservation n. 保护；节约 → conservationist n. 环保主义者
words.tip: conserve 强调“节约使用、防止浪费”；preserve 更强调“保存原状”。

words.example: Climate change is affecting rainfall patterns around the world.
words.translation: 气候变化正在影响世界各地的降雨模式。
collocations: a mild climate 温和的气候
words.family: climatic adj. 气候的
words.tip: climate 是长期的气候；weather 是某一天的具体天气。

words.example: Some deep-sea creatures can survive without sunlight.
words.translation: 有些深海生物在没有阳光的环境中也能生存。
collocations: a sea creature 海洋生物
words.family: create v. 创造 → creature n. 被创造出的生命
words.tip: creature 来自 create（创造）：被创造出来的生命体。

words.example: The drought lasted for months and dried up the river.
words.translation: 干旱持续了数月，河流都干涸了。
collocations: drought-hit areas 受灾干旱地区
words.family: drought-resistant adj. 抗旱的
words.tip: drought 的字母组合是 -ought，和 brought 一样，注意拼写。

words.example: A single species can play a key role in an ecosystem.
words.translation: 一个物种就可能在一个生态系统中发挥关键作用。
collocations: marine ecosystem 海洋生态系统
a fragile ecosystem 脆弱的生态系统
words.family: eco-（生态）＋ system（系统）
words.tip: eco- 表示“生态、环境”，常见于 ecology、eco-friendly。

words.example: The park was created to protect endangered animals.
words.translation: 这座公园的建立是为了保护濒危动物。
words.family: endanger v. 危及 → endangered adj. 濒危的；danger n. 危险
words.tip: in danger 是“处于危险中”；endangered 是“被置于危险中的”，常修饰物种。

words.example: Many species are now at risk of extinction.
words.translation: 许多物种现在面临灭绝的风险。
words.family: extinct adj. 灭绝的 → extinction n. 灭绝 → extinctive adj. 使灭绝的
words.tip: extinct 是形容词“已灭绝的”，extinction 是名词“灭绝过程”。

words.example: Building roads can destroy the natural habitat of wild animals.
words.translation: 修路可能会破坏野生动物的自然栖息地。
words.family: habitable adj. 适合居住的 → habitat n. 栖息地
words.tip: habitat 不是 habit（习惯），结尾是 -tat；habitat loss 是常见搭配。

words.example: Plastic pollution threatens birds and fish.
words.translation: 塑料污染威胁着鸟类和鱼类。
words.family: pollute v. 污染 → pollution n. 污染 → pollutant n. 污染物
words.tip: pollute 的过去分词 polluted 是“被污染的”，不要漏掉 -ed。

words.example: We need to preserve forests for future generations.
words.translation: 我们需要为子孙后代保护森林。
collocations: preserve the environment 保护环境
words.family: preservation n. 保存 → preservative n. 防腐剂
words.tip: pre-（预先）＋ serv（保持）→ 提前保护，让它保持不变。

words.example: Our class recycles paper and uses both sides of every sheet.
words.translation: 我们班回收纸张，每张纸都双面使用。
words.family: recycling n. 回收利用 → recyclable adj. 可回收的
words.tip: re-（再）＋ cycle（循环）→ 让资源重新进入循环。

words.example: Solar power is a renewable source of energy.
words.translation: 太阳能是一种可再生能源。
words.family: renew v. 更新；续期 → renewable adj. 可再生的
words.tip: re-（再）＋ new（新）→ 能够不断更新、再生的。

words.example: Fresh water is a limited resource, not an endless one.
words.translation: 淡水是一种有限资源，并非取之不尽。
collocations: a valuable resource 宝贵的资源
words.family: resourceful adj. 足智多谋的；resourcefulness n. 机智
words.tip: resourceful 不是“资源丰富的”，而是形容人“有办法、机灵的”。

words.example: The island is home to several rare bird species.
words.translation: 这座岛屿是几种珍稀鸟类的家园。
words.family: subspecies n. 亚种
words.tip: species 的单复数是同一个词形：one species, two species。

meanings: 可持续的；能长期维持的
words.example: Sustainable choices today keep the planet livable tomorrow.
words.translation: 今天可持续的选择，让地球明天依然宜居。
collocations: a sustainable lifestyle 可持续的生活方式
words.family: sustain v. 维持 → sustainable adj. 可持续的 → sustainability n. 可持续性
words.tip: sustain（支撑、维持）＋ -able（能够）→ 能长期撑下去的。

words.example: Loud boats threaten the whales that live near the coast.
words.translation: 嘈杂的船只威胁着生活在海岸附近的鲸鱼。
collocations: threaten to do 威胁要做
threaten wildlife 危及野生动物
words.family: threat n. 威胁 → threaten v. 威胁 → threatening adj. 险恶的
words.tip: threaten 后既可接人（恐吓），也可接事物（危及），看宾语判断。

words.example: The reserve gives wildlife a safe place to live.
words.translation: 保护区为野生动物提供了安全的栖息地。
collocations: protect wildlife 保护野生动物
wildlife conservation 野生动物保护
words.family: wild adj. 野生的 + life n. 生命
words.tip: wildlife 是不可数名词，通常不写 wildlifes。

words.example: The flood was a natural disaster that changed the town forever.
words.translation: 那场洪水是一场永远改变了小镇的自然灾害。
words.family: disastrous adj. 灾难性的；disastrously adv. 灾难性地
words.tip: dis-（坏）＋ aster（星）→ 古人认为星象不吉会带来灾祸。

words.example: Cycling to school is a simple way to reduce your carbon footprint.
words.translation: 骑车上学是减少碳足迹的一种简单方式。
words.family: carbon-neutral adj. 碳中和的；low-carbon adj. 低碳的
words.tip: carbon 是元素“碳”；carbon footprint 指个人或组织产生的碳排放总量。

words.example: The ancient city was buried under the sand for centuries.
words.translation: 这座古城被埋在沙下数百年。
words.family: anciently adv. 古时；antiquity n. 古代
words.tip: ancient 表示“古代”，不是“陈旧过时”；modern 才是它的常见反义。

words.example: The old town is famous for its wood-and-stone architecture.
words.translation: 这座老城以木石结构的建筑闻名。
words.family: architect n. 建筑师 → architecture n. 建筑学 → architectural adj. 建筑的
words.tip: architect 是建筑师，architecture 指建筑风格或建筑学；computer architecture 则指计算机架构。

words.example: The opening ceremony included a traditional dragon dance.
words.translation: 开幕式上表演了传统舞龙。
collocations: hold a ceremony 举行仪式
words.family: ceremonial adj. 仪式的；ceremonious adj. 讲究礼仪的
words.tip: ceremony 是正式的仪式；celebration 更强调庆祝活动本身。

words.example: The river helped an ancient civilization grow.
words.translation: 这条河流哺育了一个古代文明。
words.family: civilize v. 使文明 → civilization n. 文明 → civilized adj. 文明的
words.tip: civil（公民的）→ civilization：人们聚居、形成城市与制度的过程。

words.example: Our community organized a book drive for the village school.
words.translation: 我们社区为乡村学校组织了一次图书捐赠活动。
collocations: a sense of community 归属感
words.family: communal adj. 公共的；commune n. 公社
words.tip: community 既可以指居住的“社区”，也可以指有共同身份的“群体”。

words.example: Food is a window into cultural identity.
words.translation: 食物是了解文化认同的一扇窗口。
words.family: culture n. 文化 → cultural adj. 文化的 → culturally adv. 文化上
words.tip: cultural 是形容词，culture 是名词；常见的固定说法是 culture shock（文化冲击）。

words.example: It is a local custom to give red envelopes during Spring Festival.
words.translation: 春节期间发红包是当地的习俗。
collocations: follow a custom 遵循习俗
words.family: customary adj. 习惯性的；customer n. 顾客
words.tip: custom 是习俗；customs 还可指海关。customer 是顾客，来自“常来的人”。

words.example: The language carries a heritage that cannot be replaced.
words.translation: 这门语言承载着无法被替代的遗产。
collocations: a world heritage site 世界遗产地
words.family: inherit v. 继承 → heritage n. 遗产
words.tip: heritage 强调“继承下来的文化与传统”，不只是金钱遗产。

words.example: Many immigrants brought their food and music to the city.
words.translation: 许多移民把他们的食物和音乐带到了这座城市。
collocations: an immigrant family 移民家庭
words.family: immigrate v. 移入 → immigrant n. 移民；emigrant n. 移出者
words.tip: im-（向内）→ immigrant 是“移入者”；e-（向外）→ emigrant 是“移出者”。

words.example: According to legend, the mountain was formed by a dragon.
words.translation: 传说这座山是由一条龙化成的。
collocations: a local legend 当地传说
words.family: legendary adj. 传奇的 → legend n. 传说
words.tip: legend 既可指故事“传说”，也可指人“传奇”，如 a living legend。

words.example: Chinese literature is full of stories about friendship and courage.
words.translation: 中国文学中有许多关于友谊和勇气的故事。
words.family: literary adj. 文学的 → literature n. 文学；literate adj. 识字的
words.tip: literature 除了“文学”，在学术语境也可泛指某领域的“文献”。

words.example: The school celebrates the languages of minority groups.
words.translation: 学校庆祝少数族群的语言。
words.family: minor adj. 较小的 → minority n. 少数；反义 majority n. 多数
words.tip: minor（较小的）＋ -ity → 少数；与 majority 成对记忆。

words.example: The exhibition reflects the changing role of women in society.
words.translation: 这场展览反映了女性在社会中不断变化的角色。
collocations: reflect a change 反映变化
words.family: reflection n. 倒影；反思 → reflective adj. 反思的；反光的
words.tip: reflect on 才是“反思”；只说 reflect 常表示“反映、映出”。

words.example: Tea drinking is a daily ritual in many families.
words.translation: 喝茶在许多家庭里是一种日常仪式。
collocations: a daily ritual 日常仪式
words.family: ritually adv. 仪式性地
words.tip: ritual 比 ceremony 更强调“按固定步骤反复进行”，也可以指个人习惯。

words.example: The sculpture in the square honors a local hero.
words.translation: 广场上的雕塑纪念着一位当地的英雄。
collocations: create a sculpture 创作雕塑
words.family: sculpt v. 雕刻 → sculptor n. 雕塑家 → sculpture n. 雕塑
words.tip: sculptor 是“雕塑家”，sculpture 是“雕塑作品或艺术”；不要写成 sculpter。

words.example: In many cultures, the dove symbolizes peace.
words.translation: 在许多文化中，鸽子象征和平。
words.family: symbol n. 象征 → symbolize v. 象征 → symbolic adj. 象征性的
words.tip: symbol（象征）＋ -ize（使成为）→ 使某物成为象征。

words.example: Keeping the tradition alive takes effort from the whole community.
words.translation: 让传统延续下去，需要整个社区共同努力。
collocations: a family tradition 家族传统
keep a tradition alive 让传统延续
words.family: traditional adj. 传统的 → traditionally adv. 传统上
words.tip: tradition 可数：某一种具体传统可以说 a tradition，泛指则用 tradition。

words.example: London is one of the most diverse cities in the world.
words.translation: 伦敦是世界上最多元的城市之一。
collocations: a diverse range of 各种各样的
words.family: diversity n. 多样性 → diversify v. 使多样化 → diverse adj. 多样的
words.tip: diverse 强调“种类多、彼此不同”；不要与 divert（转移）混淆。

words.example: Pop music has a strong influence on the way young people speak.
words.translation: 流行音乐对年轻人的说话方式有很大影响。
collocations: have an influence on 对……有影响
influence sb to do 促使某人做
words.family: influential adj. 有影响力的 → influence n./v. 影响
words.tip: 名词搭配 have an influence on；动词直接及物：influence young people。

words.example: Language is an important part of cultural identity.
words.translation: 语言是文化认同的重要组成部分。
collocations: a sense of identity 身份认同感
words.family: identify v. 辨认；确认 → identity n. 身份 → identical adj. 完全相同的
words.tip: identity 是“身份、认同”，identify 是动词“识别”；注意拼写中的 -tity。

words.example: The editorial advocates protecting green spaces in the city.
words.translation: 这篇社论主张保护城市里的绿地。
collocations: advocate doing sth 主张做某事
words.family: advocacy n. 倡导；advocate n. 拥护者
words.tip: advocate 后常接动名词：advocate doing，不常接 to do。

words.example: A clear argument needs evidence, not just strong feelings.
words.translation: 清晰的论点需要证据，而不只是强烈的情感。
collocations: make an argument 提出论点
a powerful argument 有力的论证
words.family: argue v. 争论；主张 → argument n. 论点；争吵
words.tip: argument 不一定是“吵架”，议论文中的 argument 多指“论点、论证”。

words.example: Could you clarify what you mean by 'success'?
words.translation: 你能说明一下你说的“成功”是什么意思吗？
collocations: clarify a point 澄清观点
words.family: clear adj. 清楚的 → clarify v. 澄清 → clarity n. 清晰
words.tip: clarify 不是“分类”，而是把含混的地方说清楚；名词 clarity。

words.example: The writer reaches the conclusion that small choices matter.
words.translation: 作者得出结论：微小的选择也很重要。
collocations: draw a conclusion 得出结论
words.family: conclude v. 推断；结束 → conclusion n. 结论
words.tip: draw / reach / come to a conclusion 都可表示“得出结论”。

words.example: He accepted the criticism and improved his essay.
words.translation: 他接受了批评，并改进了自己的文章。
words.family: criticize v. 批评 → criticism n. 批评 → critical adj. 批判性的；关键的
words.tip: criticism 可以是中性的“评析”，constructive criticism 就是有用的反馈。

words.example: There is strong evidence that sleep improves memory.
words.translation: 有充分证据表明睡眠能改善记忆。
words.family: evident adj. 明显的 → evidence n. 证据 → evidently adv. 显然
words.tip: evidence 通常不可数：a piece of evidence，不用 an evidence。

words.example: Don't exaggerate the problem; describe what actually happened.
words.translation: 不要夸大问题，客观描述实际发生了什么。
collocations: exaggerate the importance 夸大重要性
words.family: exaggeration n. 夸张 → exaggerated adj. 夸张的
words.tip: ex-（向外）＋ agger（堆）→ 往外堆得太多，就是夸大。

words.example: The chart illustrates how study time changes during exam week.
words.translation: 这张图表说明了考试周学习时间的变化。
collocations: illustrate a point 说明观点
an illustrated book 带插图的书籍
words.family: illustration n. 插图；说明 → illustrator n. 插画师
words.tip: illustrate 不只是“画插图”，阅读题里常表示“举例说明”。

words.example: The last sentence implies that the narrator will leave.
words.translation: 最后一句暗示叙述者将会离开。
words.family: implication n. 含义；暗示 → implied adj. 隐含的
words.tip: 作者 imply（暗示），读者 infer（推断）；阅读题常考这两个词的区分。

words.example: Different readers may interpret the ending in different ways.
words.translation: 不同的读者可能会以不同方式理解这个结局。
collocations: interpret a text 解读文本
interpret for sb 为某人口译
words.family: interpretation n. 解读；口译 → interpreter n. 口译者
words.tip: interpret 是“解读意义”，而不是简单 translate（翻译字面）。

words.example: The reporter investigated why so much food was wasted.
words.translation: 记者调查了为什么会有这么多食物被浪费。
collocations: investigate a case 调查案件
investigate how 调查……如何发生
words.family: investigation n. 调查 → investigator n. 调查者
words.tip: investigate 是及物动词，直接跟调查对象，不说 investigate about。

words.example: From a historical perspective, the change seems small.
words.translation: 从历史的视角来看，这个变化似乎很微小。
collocations: a fresh perspective 新的视角
words.family: perspectival adj. 视角的；perspective 本身也可作“洞察力”
words.tip: per-（穿过）＋ spect（看）→ 透过某个角度去看。

words.example: Good writing can persuade readers to care about an issue.
words.translation: 好的写作能说服读者去关心一个问题。
collocations: persuade sb to do 说服某人做
be persuaded that 被说服相信
words.family: persuasion n. 说服 → persuasive adj. 有说服力的
words.tip: persuade 强调“说服成功”；try to persuade 才是“试图说服”。

words.example: Choose precise words instead of vague ones.
words.translation: 选择准确的词，而不是含糊的词。
collocations: to be precise 确切地说
words.family: precision n. 精确 → precise adj. 精确的 → precisely adv. 精确地
words.tip: precise 强调细节“准确”；accurate 强调与事实“相符”，常可互换。

words.example: She opened her speech with a quote from a poet.
words.translation: 她用一位诗人的话作为演讲的开头。
words.family: quotation n. 引语 → quote v. 引用
words.tip: quote 可作名词“引语”；quotation 更正式，也指“报价单”。

words.example: In one sentence, summarize the main idea of the passage.
words.translation: 用一句话概括文章的主旨。
collocations: summarize the main points 概括要点
words.family: summary n. 摘要 → summarize v. 总结 → summarization n. 概括
words.tip: summarize 是动词，summary 是名词；写作结尾常用 to sum up。

words.example: The instructions were straightforward, so we finished quickly.
words.translation: 说明简单明了，所以我们很快就完成了。
collocations: a straightforward answer 直截了当的回答
words.family: straightforwardly adv. 直接地；straightforwardness n. 坦率
words.tip: straight（直）＋ forward（向前）→ 不绕弯子，直截了当。

words.example: Use a transition to connect your two paragraphs.
words.translation: 用一个过渡句把两段连接起来。
collocations: a smooth transition 平稳的过渡
transition from A to B 从 A 向 B 过渡
words.family: transit v./n. 经过 → transition n. 过渡 → transitional adj. 过渡的
words.tip: transition 在写作里指“衔接”，常见信号词有 however、therefore 等。

words.example: Your opinion is valid, but the evidence you chose is weak.
words.translation: 你的观点是合理的，但你选择的证据不够有力。
collocations: a valid argument 有效的论证
words.family: validity n. 有效性 → validate v. 验证；确认
words.tip: valid 不只指“有效”，也可以指观点“站得住脚、有道理”。

words.example: The writer's vivid description made the old street come alive.
words.translation: 作者生动的描写让那条老街跃然纸上。
collocations: vivid imagination 丰富的想象力
words.family: vividly adv. 生动地；vividness n. 生动
words.tip: vivid 来自“活着”，所以描写 vivid 就像让画面活了起来。
